items.headline: High Surf Advisory issued November 21 at 1:32AM EST until November 22 at 2:00AM EST by NWS Charleston SC
items.description:
* WHAT...Large breaking waves of 4 to 6 feet in the surf zone.

* WHERE...Charleston County.

* WHEN...Until 2 AM EST Sunday.

* IMPACTS...Dangerous swimming and surfing conditions and
localized beach erosion.

* ADDITIONAL DETAILS...In addition to high surf, beach erosion is
likely to occur.
items.instruction:
Inexperienced swimmers should remain out of the water due to
dangerous surf conditions.

items.headline: Gale Warning issued November 21 at 1:26AM EST until November 21 at 5:00PM EST by NWS Charleston SC
items.description:
* WHAT...Northeast winds 20 to 30 kt with gusts up to 35 kt and
seas 6 to 11 ft.

* WHERE...South Santee River to Edisto Beach out 20 NM.

* WHEN...Until 5 PM EST this afternoon.

* IMPACTS...Strong winds will cause hazardous seas which could
capsize or damage vessels and reduce visibility.
items.instruction:
Mariners should alter plans to avoid these hazardous conditions.
Remain in port, seek safe harbor, alter course, and/or secure the
vessel for hazardous conditions.
